These images are from the ZXing project's blackbox test suite
(https://github.com/zxing/zxing, core/src/test/resources/blackbox/<set>/<file>),
Copyright ZXing authors, licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
File names are <set>_<original name>; the expected texts are the ZXing .txt files
(and, for upcean-extension-1, the SUGGESTED_PRICE from the .metadata.txt files).

Sets: aztec-2, codabar-1, code128-1, code93-1, datamatrix-1, datamatrix-2, ean13-1,
ean8-1, itf-1, maxicode-1, pdf417-2, pdf417-3, qrcode-1, qrcode-2, qrcode-3, rss14-1,
rssexpanded-1, upce-1, upcean-extension-1.

Files named *-gray.png were converted from RGB to 8-bit grayscale (ITU-R 601 luma, the
same conversion the decoder applies) to keep the repository small: ean13-1_3,
itf-1_2, itf-1_3, upcean-extension-1_2.
